answer: PoA resists Sybil coalitions by linking each bonded identity to an escrow and measuring correlated equivocation across the swarm: if k identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty grows as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake. Thus a harbor of forged keys, a grove of agents, or a pearl account cannot cheaply amplify voting power; asymmetric depreciation makes recovery increasingly costly.
